title: MIRIO TOGATA My Hero Academia Craftables Buildable Action Figure Series 3 NEW
descriptionText:
This MIRIO TOGATA My Hero Academia Craftables Buildable Action Figure Series 3 is a must-have for any anime and manga fan. The figure features Mirio Togata and Tamaki Amajiki characters from the popular TV show and franchise. The 1:24 scale action figure is an original, licensed reproduction from Just Toys Intl and comes in its original, unopened packaging.

Perfect for all occasions, this collectible is a great addition to any animation merchandise collection. The figure is not signed and is not vintage. It was manufactured in 2022 and belongs to the Anime & Manga theme. This item is a series 3 craftable action figure and is perfect for building and displaying.
